test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What does PYKKA stand for in the context of sports?

options.text: Panchayat Yojana Kendra for Kids Activities
Panchayat Yuva Krida Aur Khel Abhiyan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Panchayat Yuva Krida Aur Khel Abhiyan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PYKKA** stands for **Panchayat Yuva Krida Aur Khel Abhiyan**, which was a **Centrally Sponsored Scheme** launched by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of **India**. ***Hence, option D is correct.***
 
• The scheme was formally launched in the year **2008** with the primary objective of promoting **sports** and **games** in **rural areas** of the **country**. ***Hence, the option naming Kids Activities or Public Youth Krida is incorrect.***
 
• It aimed at the development and maintenance of basic **sports infrastructure** at the **Village** and **Block Panchayat** levels. This was designed to provide **youth** in **villages** with opportunities to participate in organized **sports competitions**.
 
• The scheme intended to cover all **2.5 lakh Village Panchayats** and **6,373 Block Panchayats** across **India** over a period of **10 years**. It provided **one-time capital grants** and **annual operational grants** for the upkeep of playfields.
 
• By encouraging **sports culture** at the grassroots level, **PYKKA** sought to tap into **rural talent** and integrate it with the mainstream **national sports** framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Evolution of the Scheme:**

 
 
• In **April 2014**, the **PYKKA** scheme was revamped and renamed as the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Abhiyan (RGKA)**. This change was aimed at addressing gaps in **infrastructure** and providing more structured **training** facilities.
 
• Later, in **2016**, the **RGKA** was merged along with other schemes like the **Urban Sports Infrastructure Scheme (USIS)** and the **National Sports Talent Search Scheme (NSTSS)** into the unified **Khelo India: National Programme for Development of Sports**.
 
 
 
• **Implementation Strategy:**
 
 
• The scheme utilized **Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs)** for implementation, ensuring local **governance** and community participation.
 
• The **central government** provided **75%** of the **funding** for **infrastructure** development, while the remaining **25%** was contributed by the **State Governments** (for **North-Eastern States**, the ratio was **90:10**).
 
 
 
• **Competitions and Awards:**
 
 
• Under **PYKKA**, annual **competitions** were organized at the **Block**, **District**, **State**, and **National levels**. These competitions specifically targeted **rural youth** to ensure **talent identification**.
 
• The scheme also focused on **Women's Sports** through special **National Sports Festivals for Women** and **North-East Sports Festivals** to promote **inclusive participation**.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of Current Successor (Khelo India):**
 
 
• The **Khelo India** scheme, which succeeded **PYKKA**, now provides a **financial assistance** of **INR 5 lakh** per annum for **8 years** to talented **athletes** identified in priority **sports disciplines**.
 
• It has expanded the scope from simple **rural playfields** to **high-performance centers** and **State Centers of Excellence**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Target Demographic:** The scheme primarily focused on the **age group** of **adolescents** and **young adults** living in **rural sectors** who lacked access to modern **gymnasiums** or **stadiums**.
 
• **Administrative Body:** The **Sports Authority of India (SAI)** played a crucial role in providing **technical support** and conducting **coaching camps** during the active years of the **PYKKA** program.
 
• **Geographical Reach:** It was implemented across all **States** and **Union Territories** of **India**, with special emphasis on **LWE (Left Wing Extremism)** affected districts to engage **youth** constructively.
